evidenceBoundary.exact: Complete current unwind-owned helper bytes, integer widths and local branch grammar. Actual parent caller transfers supply selectors one and zero and the original compatible receiver/context/key arguments.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Unsigned16 count/counter record scan compares the stored context pointer, sign-extends the dword offset-plus-selector, computes a pair address and loads its function/context qwords together. Fallback arguments and ordinary indirect arguments/return are preserved. The pointer-identity predicate branch returns true or false in AL through the complete restored frame.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Anonymous class/record/pair/payload storage expressions. Compiler specialization addresses and interface-like selector patterns do not by themselves identify the live closed interface, slot, target or MethodInfo.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Requires stable valid compatible nonnull receiver/class/context/record/pair/stack storage, normal compatible preparation/resolver/child returns and compatible selected payload buffers. Counter exhaustion before UInt16 wrap follows from its zero initialization, unsigned comparisons and count width. Active error/helper effects are inventoried but not inferred.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Named runtime interface/class/MethodInfo bridge, actual specialization choice, word hash and predicate equality meaning of opaque child calls, live cache and setter mutation, array callback target/cursor and positive list/root admission.
